title: When life starts asking what it is for
issueStatement: The schedule may be full, yet the soul keeps asking what all this effort finally serves.
centralInsight: Gurbani frames human life as a chance for meeting, service, and Naam. Purpose becomes clearer when life is received as trust, not merely managed as maintenance.
practicalReflection: Loss of purpose is not always dramatic. Often it appears when daily work is no longer connected to devotion, usefulness, or the Giver.
actionPrompt: Before the next task swallows the hour, choose one act that answers life as calling rather than maintenance.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: When purpose needs a repeatable shape
practice.issueStatement: The schedule may be full, yet the soul keeps asking what all this effort finally serves. Inspiration is not the main need now; a repeatable return is.
practice.centralInsight: Gurbani frames human life as a chance for meeting, service, and Naam. Purpose becomes clearer when life is received as trust, not merely managed as maintenance. What is repeated with honesty begins to retrain the reflex itself.
practice.practicalReflection: A kept rule is gentler than a burst of intensity and usually more transformative. The aim is not to feel moved once, but to become more faithful in the next moment.
